messages.subject: Project Yarrow — LTSA mark-up (Caldera)
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Thank you for the draft. Our mark-up is attached (tracked). The substantive moves from Caldera's side:
- Liability cap: increased to 150% of annual charges (we think 125% is light for a programme of this value).
- Delay termination trigger: tightened from 8 weeks to 4 weeks on any ship-set, given the assembly-line dependency.
- Minimum-volume shortfall: reduced to 20%, with a proviso disapplying the charge where under-ordering results from a CAA/EASA type-certification delay outside Caldera's control.

The rest is largely clarificatory. Happy to talk it through.

Alistair
Pemberton Rowe LLP

messages.plaintextBody:
Alistair,

Thanks — received. We'll take instructions, but a first reaction: the 4-week termination trigger is too tight for the ramp phase and we'll push back toward 6 weeks. We can find a landing on the cap and we're broadly comfortable with the certification-delay relief on the minimum, suitably bounded. Elena will turn a counter-draft.

James

--
